name: Development evolution
intent: When the same work keeps failing the same way, change the development system rather than retrying the work.

trigger.note: The keywords are failure *recurrence*, not the names of the things a development-system change touches. They were `workflow`, `routing` and `harness` for a release, and every piece of harness work therefore routed here — `build the harness workflow executor` scored 7 and went to the workflow whose intent is "when the same work keeps failing the same way, change the development system rather than retrying the work". Touching the harness is a place, not a kind of work; this workflow is for the kind.

steps.name: Gather development telemetry
steps.note: `noetic-harness telemetry --clusters` is this step. It refuses to report a cluster below ten recorded runs and says how many more it needs — three failures out of three observations is all the data there is, not a pattern, and an experiment opened against it optimises the measure of the process rather than the work. Below the floor, this workflow stops here.

steps.name: Find the weakness cluster — a task family, not an anecdote
steps.note: Three failures of the same shape. One failure is a bug; the workflow is not the defect yet.

steps.name: What about the development system caused this
steps.note: Example: repeated TypeDB migration regressions → a dedicated migration review is missing.

steps.name: Change one thing — a role, a gate, a context rule, a skill, a routing rule
Run the weakness cluster against both
Update routing knowledge, not the constitution

escalations.when: the hypothesis implicates the constitution, trust levels or gate definitions
the weakness is a missing capability rather than a bad route

completion: the cluster is a family, not an anecdote
memory: the weakness cluster and what fixed it, so the next cluster is recognised sooner
